openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: The TD-W8970 v1 is a 450Mbps Wireless N Gigabit ADSL2+ / VDSL2 Modem Router, but is marketed as a 300Mbps and only ADSL2+ capable product. The TD-W8970 v3 is a Broadcom router which is not supported by OpenWrt. Very similar to TD-W8980 and TD-W9980.
Supported Versions: switch is passing traffic (tagged + untagged), but passing it to all ports https://dev.openwrt.org/ticket/15511
openwrt_wiki.Installation: classic method using serial access (U-Boot: press 't', tftpboot, sf erase/write) oder Methode ohne Öffnen über die Weboberfläche (siehe Geräteseite); ab FW-Build 12.10.2013 nimmt die TP-Link-Weboberfläche nur signierte Images an
openwrt_wiki.Openwrt Performance: about 25MBps=400mbps on gigabit lan and 5MBps=40mbps on wireless (Video)
openwrt_wiki.Failsafe mode: nach Einschalten 45 s lang einmal pro Sekunde WPS drücken (Factory Reset), danach LAN1 192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.DSL Settings: Default annex a, tone av, xfer_mode atm; Annex B: annex=b, tone=bv, xfer_mode=ptm (kmod-ltq-ptm-vr9)
openwrt_wiki.LEDs: WPS-LED als Status-LED (Power-LED nicht steuerbar); seit r48041 geht sie nach dem Boot aus

Hardware Info.Bootloader: U-Boot 2010.06-LANTIQ-v-2.0.40-svn2583 (press t to enter U-Boot console on OEM firmware)
Hardware Info.RAM Chip: Hynix H5PS5162GFR-Y5C, other Winbond W9751G6KB or Zentel A3R12E40CBF
Hardware Info.Ethernet: 4x 10/100/1000 BASE-TX Ethernet Interface (2x XWAY VR9 GPHY 11G & 2x XWAY PEF7071 via RGMII)
Hardware Info.xDSL: Lantiq XWAY VRX208: ADSL1/2/2+ (G.992.1/3/5) Annexes A, B, I, J, M, L, VDSL1 (G.993.1, T1.424, TS 101 270), VDSL2 (G.993.2), ITU-T G 998.2 Bonding, EFM (IEEE 802.3ah)
Hardware Info.GPIO Buttons: WPS button, WiFi toggle switch, Reset button
Hardware Info.GPIO LEDs: ADSL, Internet, WPS, USB Port 1, USB Port 2

openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: Remove four screw; carefully unhook the plastic clips that fasten the upper and bottom cover

Serial.Hint: If you are soldering headers to the board, the GND point can be quite tricky because it is not drilled all the way through. There is, however, a via marked "GND3" closeby you can alternatively use.
Serial.U-Boot: Press t on the console to interrupt U-Boot autobooting. Login admin/1234

openwrt_wiki.UART Boot: Temporarily connect the left side of R225 to GND, to get into UART mode (ROM VER: 1.1.4, CFG 04); UART-U-Boot von github.com/mkresin/u-boot
